topic: After finishing a big slice of cake, the student suddenly craves something salty to balance it out and can't decide what to grab.
core_question: The student pushes the tutor to name the perfect salty snack to follow dessert.
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang

messages.content: yo just demolished this huge slice of cake and now i need something salty asap. whats good?
